name: Sanyo Chemical Industries, Ltd.
summary: Sanyo Chemical Industries, Ltd. manufactures and sells chemical products in Japan. It offers multiple specialty categories, including extracellular vesicle purification kits, plant-derived textiles, fluidity improvers, nonionic surfactants, polyurethane materials, anionic surfactants, and antimicrobial agents, lubricants, polypropylene glycol derivatives, nonionic surfactants, dispersants, rust inhibitors, nonionic surfactants for cleaning applications, sizing agents, aminoalkyl methacrylate monomers, tooling boards, and antistatic agents, plastic additives, functional chemicals, pressure sensitive adhesives, UV curing resins, and cosmetic raw materials.
